conventions.t: seconds from the array audio start
conventions.along_m / ahead_m: head position in the array frame: along the mic axis (mic 5 -> mic 10) and in front of it, from the pair centre
conventions.lateral_deg / truth_deg: the exact two-mic angle to the head as the schemes define it
conventions.facing_deg: 0 = the head faces the array, 180 = faces away
conventions.speech: the talker's voice activity, [start, end] seconds
conventions.dim: brief 11 rule, margin part only (these records carry no pause share): dim when the top two shares differ by < 0.203
conventions.range_rel: provisional: 10^((cdr_anchor - cdr)/20), anchored on the first lone onset facing the array within 30 deg; brief 20 settles the rule
